definition: The specific threshold at which a scored detector or selector is actually used, as distinct from a summary statistic integrated over all thresholds -- and in these sources repeatedly the place where the result lives. The contamination-calibration work makes the divergence quantitative: the same correction is worth one to four points of area under the curve and five to fifteen points of true positive rate at a five percent false-positive threshold, because the summary integrates over thresholds nobody deploys. The hallucination-detection work sweeps its decoding threshold and reports the trade rather than only the chosen point, with a more aggressive setting cutting hallucination a further 36 percent while removing 12 percent of correct mentions. The steering audit shows the third failure mode, that no fixed operating point is comparable across models at all -- both an apparent emergence and an apparent collapse of steerability are artifacts of holding layer and coefficient fixed, removed only by selecting the point on held-out data. And the probing sweep finds the best read-out location reversing between benchmarks. The shared rule is that where a detector's two error types have different costs, the summary statistic is a screening device and the operating point is the claim, and it must be selected on data other than the data it is reported on.

evidence.note: Audits four neuroscience-inspired claims about language models across 17 checkpoints from five families and 0.6B to 72B, and shows that an apparent emergence of concept steerability with scale is produced entirely by uncalibrated measurement -- raw intervention units, the readout metric, and a fixed operating point -- with correcting any one of the three removing the trend.
evidence.title: When Is a Steerable Concept Representation Real? Measurement Confounds in a Cross-Family Audit of Neuroscience Parallels in LLMs

evidence.note: Asks whether a published internal signal for code correctness is a property of the model or of the one extraction recipe used to find it, sweeps every design choice systematically, and finds no configuration is best anywhere -- with the benchmark deciding which choice wins, and a mismatched fitting source able to drive the signal below chance.
evidence.title: On the Robustness of LLMs' Internal Representation of Code Correctness

evidence.note: Calibrates feature-based data-contamination detectors against the systematic feature shifts that post-training introduces, by measuring how controlled prompt variants move scores on known non-members and then correcting only the recurring shift directions, with the gains concentrated at the low-false-positive operating point rather than in AUC.
evidence.title: Calibrating Post-Training Feature Shifts for LLM Data Contamination Detection

evidence.note: Reads a frozen vision-language model's forward pass as a structured computational trace -- a graph over image patches, query tokens and generated tokens with attention as edges, processed by interleaved relational, spatial and sequential modules -- and shows that structuring the same internals prior detectors already read lifts hallucination detection from a 69-75 AUC plateau to 90.
evidence.title: UniProbe: A Learnable Token-Level Hallucination Detector for Large VLMs using Multi-Structural Internal Representations

name: operating point
